description: Create or edit a popup (modal, slide-in, fullscreen, announcement bar via show.as barTop/barBottom), or send settings / look for the site-wide rules / look. One target per call. Staged: live at publish_site. New: template + fill, or name + show.as + where.include + body. Edit: send only what changes; objects merge, null removes an optional key, arrays replace. id + status alone starts or stops it; add publish:true to apply it now (use for a stop). get_skill('popups') first.

body.description: Full body HTML (replaces it). No <script> or on*=.

css.description: The popup's own CSS, unprefixed (dotsy scopes it). "" clears.

fill.description: Fill-ins by name: {headline, text, buttonLink, image:{src,alt}}. Also edits an existing popup.

id.description: Edit this popup, or create with this id. Omit to create.

labels.description: Form words, merged; "" clears one. Default: site formWords, else built-in.

look.description: Site look: {vars:{font, headingFont, text, heading, bg, link, accent, accentText, radius, shadow, fieldBorder, fieldBg, fieldRadius}, button:{classes, sample}|null, read:{page} re-reads the site, reset}.

publish.description: With id + status only: publish that status now.

settings.description: Site-wide rules: {slots:{overlay 0-3, barTop 0-1, barBottom 0-1}, maxPerVisit 1-10, mobileGuard: hold full-screen popups on phones}.

show.description: {as: modal|slideIn|fullscreen|barTop|barBottom, position, overlay, style, animation, closeButton, pushContent, closeOnOverlay, closeOnEsc, scrollLock, tablet, phone}

template.description: Template id to create from (view templates). Starts paused.

when.description: {any:[{delay:secs}|{scroll:%}|{exit:{sensitivity}}|{click:selector}]}: opens on the first; [] = only from a link or JS.

where.description: {include:[paths, one trailing * allowed], exclude:[paths]}; exclude wins.

name: put_popup
